topic: Complete wiring: ignition, stop button and throttle sensor
statement: The 2023-2026 CRF150R has no battery and a very small harness: an ignition control module with a 6-pin and a 4-pin connector, an exciter coil and ignition pulse generator on the engine, a direct ignition coil on the plug, a throttle position sensor and the engine stop button. Exciter coil: white and blue. Ignition pulse generator: blue/yellow and green/white. Direct ignition coil: black/yellow from the module and green ground. Throttle position sensor: black/blue, yellow and black at the module (blue, yellow and black on the sensor's own pigtail). Engine stop button: black/white and black/green; pressing it joins the two, and black/green ties into the green ground. Module 6-pin connector wires: green, black, green/white, black/blue, yellow, blue/yellow. Module 4-pin connector wires: blue, black/white, white, black/yellow. Honda's colour letters: Bl black, Y yellow, Bu blue, G green, R red, W white, Br brown, O orange, Lb light blue, Lg light green, P pink, Gr gray.

vals.tps: Bl/Bu, Y, Bl (sensor side Bu, Y, Bl)
vals.icm_6p: G, Bl, G/W, Bl/Bu, Y, Bu/Y

notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.
